positions.as_written: Start with radiographs, since they show the implants and the bone position with least artefact.
Use a post-operative magnetic resonance protocol when soft tissue is the question.
Repeat the measurements that led to the operation rather than looking at the repair alone.
Compare with the pre-operative study wherever one exists.
- The original measurements should be repeated.
The pre-operative measurements should be repeated on the post-operative study using the same convention.
- The report should state what the artefact prevented.
